body:
***1\. Ligation L11 reconstitution***

*lig147-L11 (D8)*

Use 2 ug of DNA

lig147-L11 ⇒ 7.7 nM

Octamer molarity acc. to 60:1 ratio ⇒ 462 nM ⇒1.01 ug in 5 uL ⇒ Prepare 12 uL of stock with 500 ng/uL with refolding buffer \[1.11 uL stock \+ 10.89 uL refolding buffer\] \[O500\] ⇒ Prepare 5 uL octamer stock \[3.92 uL \+ 1.08 uL refolding buffer \+ glycerol\] \[1.78 M\] ⇒ Final concentration of mix \[1.95 M\]
